relative_change.eligibility: baseline must be finite and non-zero
relative_change.selection_rule: fixed before outcome modeling; never selected on test performance

clinical_contract.categorical_missing: explicit __MISSING__ level learned without test vocabulary

classification_rule.supported_increment: paired 95% CI for delta AUROC is above zero at two or more timings, including at least one of T0-T2
classification_rule.any_increment_signal: paired 95% CI for C+FULL minus C+F delta AUROC is above zero at one or more timings
classification_rule.residual_signal: paired 95% CI for residualized delta AUROC is above zero at one or more timings
classification_rule.standalone_signal: OOF AUROC >= 0.60 at one or more timings
classification_rule.profile_signal: NONFTV (N), not merely FULL, has OOF AUROC >= 0.60 for HR, HER2, or subtype at one or more timings
classification_rule.b_ftv_redundant: standalone_signal AND NOT any_increment_signal AND NOT residual_signal
classification_rule.c_profile_only: profile_signal AND NOT standalone_signal AND NOT any_increment_signal AND NOT residual_signal
classification_rule.d_weak: NOT standalone_signal AND NOT profile_signal AND NOT any_increment_signal AND NOT residual_signal
classification_rule.mixed_rule: if no A/B/C/D conjunction is satisfied, report MIXED/INCONCLUSIVE instead of forcing an unsupported mechanistic label
